title: Member Services Policy: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Enrollment Conditions
content:
**Section 1. Voluntary enrollment.** PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment is voluntary and is taken only at the member's request.

**Section 2. Rate schedule and member type.** The service account must be on a rate schedule that is marked eligible for prepay and that is listed among the tier's eligible rate schedules, and the member type on the member profile must be among the tier's eligible member types.

**Section 3. Open service account.** The service account must be in active or disconnect pending status at enrollment.

**Section 4. Meter.** The service account's meter type must equal the meter type the tier requires, because disconnection and reconnection are performed remotely.

**Section 5. Medical certificate protection.** An account under medical certificate protection cannot enroll, and enrollment is refused while the service account's medical certificate expiry date is on or after the current date. This exclusion is the medical-certificate switch of the program, which is set to not allowed on every tier.

**Section 6. Budget Billing and payment arrangements.** Because PrePay Power is compatible neither with Budget Billing nor with payment arrangements, an active Budget Billing plan on the service account must be ended and settled first, and an active payment arrangement on the service account must be ended first; its unbilled arranged balance then becomes part of the transferred arrears.

**Section 7. Re-enrollment wait.** A service account converted out of PrePay Power may enroll again only after the tier's re-enrollment wait (90 calendar days on every tier) has passed since the previous PrePay Power account on the same service account was converted. Calendar days are counted from the day after the ended date, the last waiting day being the last day of the count; enrollment is possible only once that count is complete, never on the last waiting day itself.

**Section 8. Fees and deposits.** No enrollment fee is charged and, because no deposit is required on the program, no new deposit is assessed while on the program.

**Section 9. Basis.** Every condition above is judged on the cooperative's records for the service account being enrolled (its schedule, status, meter type, medical certificate expiry date, Budget Billing plan, payment arrangement and earlier PrePay Power accounts), not on the member's description of them.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Situation | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Medical certificate expiry date equals the current date | refused under Section 5 |
| Medical certificate expiry date is the day before the current date | Section 5 does not refuse |
| Previous enrollment ended (converted) on 1 March; enrollment asked on 30 May | 30 May is the 90th waiting day (2 March is day 1), so refused |
| Same, enrollment asked on 31 May | the 90 days have passed, so Section 7 does not refuse |
| Service account in disconnect pending status | Section 3 is met |
